div.head: VII Atr 2.2a
div.ab: Et super hoc cantet omnis presbiter XXX missas et omnis diaconus et clericus XXX psalmos.
Et super hoc cantet omnis presbiter xxx missas et omnis diaconus et clericus xxx psalmos.
And in addition every priest shall sing 30 masses, and every deacon and cleric 30 psalms.
Und ausserdem singe jeder Priester dreissig Messen und jeder Diakon und Kleriker dreissig Psalmen.
And in addition let every priest sing thirty masses and every deacon and clerk thirty psalms.
